title: Usage on backgrounds
slide_intent: Teach designers to judge how a multicolor mark reads against its ground. Holding the signature fixed makes the effect of changing the background easy to compare.
strategic_value: Slack can present its four-color mark on a limited set of grounds while keeping the lettering distinguishable.
demonstration: Three aligned horizontal lockups sit on white, black and aubergine. Their colored symbols stay constant while the wordmark changes between dark and light.
practical_value: Choose an approved ground before placing the full-color asset. On photography, check that the area directly behind it is black or white.

content_islands.name: Page heading
content_islands.spec: Place the small bold title at upper left above a horizontal rule spanning the page.

content_islands.name: Background guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the approved grounds and the photography condition in a short left-hand column.

content_islands.name: Ground comparison
content_islands.spec: Stack three equally wide color fields on the right. Center the lockup at the same size in each and change the lettering for the light or dark ground.

content_islands.name: Running footer
content_islands.spec: Below a thin rule at the foot, align the folio, book title and Design elements section label.
